title: Dynamic Text in Photoshop: Auto-Format, Centering, and Masking Behind Objects (Day 14)
summary: This PHLEARN tutorial (Day 14 of 30 Days of Photoshop) guides viewers through typography basics with the Type tool and the new dynamic text feature. It starts with standard text setup: choosing font, size, weight, alignment, and manual controls for leading and tracking, including mixing bold and regular within a single line and adjusting line breaks. It then introduces dynamic text, demonstrating how converting to dynamic text makes text auto-fit to its bounding box and remain editable, with real-time reflow as the box is resized. Finally, the lesson shows a practical compositing trick: masking the ocean background and unlinking the dynamic text from the mask so the text can sit behind a foreground object (a fish) for a high-end look, with guidance on moving and editing text even after masking.
